thesis: The page is the architect's window schedule for one Sarasota house: every section is an opening that gets a hexagon tag, a jamb-section frame and a row that fills in the schedule as you read, so the quote you get looks exactly like the page you just scrolled.

signature.name: Opening Schedule (Hex Tag + Jamb Section)
signature.summary: An architectural hexagon opening tag (W1, W2, D1) hung by a thin string, a drawn jamb cross-section frame (head drip, side jambs, sloped sill with sill pan) around every photo, and a sticky schedule strip whose rows fill with size, glass and status as each opening-section passes; the price block is the full schedule sheet and the footer closes it with a signed inspection row.

palette.family: Sarasota Coral + Sea-Glass Teal + Drafting Navy + Shell Sand

layoutMoves: a 2-column margin rail on desktop (12-col grid, cols 1-2) that carries each section's hex tag and its schedule row
every photo sits in a drawn jamb-section frame with a sloped sill shelf that text and tags sit on
the price section is a full-width ruled schedule sheet (tag | opening | size | glass | sample range | status) instead of cards

motion.intro: 0-1.1s: the jamb frame draws round the hero photo (head 0-.35s, jambs .35-.7s, sill .7-.9s), then the W1 tag swings in on its string (rotate -8deg to 0, .3s, no bounce); text is visible from frame 0
stories: process: pinned from 640px, six openings W1 Measure, W2 Order, W3 Remove, D1 Set, W4 Seal, W5 Inspect; the schedule strip rows tick from 'open' to a teal check and the size column counts in
schedule sheet: rows draw their ruled lines left to right with 60ms stagger as the table enters
motion.hover: a teal hairline under the item grows from the left like a pencil rule (scaleX 0 to 1, 200ms)
